headline: T Mobile (TMUS) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Despite Recent Pressure
summary: T-Mobile US stock has fallen this year but still sits on a 3 year gain, and with valuation checks sending a mixed signal, investors are weighing whether the recent pullback has simply brought the price closer to fair or hinted at deeper concerns.
